name: friday-ai
description: Friday AI skills: branch-aware project context recall plus requirement-to-MR automation through the Friday MCP server. 6 skills (friday / friday-dev / friday-solution / friday-code / friday-feishu / friday-memory) covering local branch context recall (progress / PRD / feature list / continue-where-you-left-off), feature-list-to-technical-solution (new-vs-modify classification, repository confirmation, per-repo + overall plan), repository discovery, GraphRAG analysis, coding plans, containerized execution, MR creation, Feishu work item workflows, and delivery memory. Hooks auto-inject project context per prompt and silently capture session learnings back to Friday.
